notes.title: Version 1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Applied another fix to a niche issue where two copies of a level could be loaded at once.

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Modified the key combo used to activate cheats to be much harder to hit by accident.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Added dynamic optimization levels to an effect on the main menu to better support graphics cards with less VRAM.
Added in a couple more loading messages.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Update - New Content!
notes.content:
New Content


Added a new level, Hungry House!  This level is selectable under "Bonus Levels".
There's a new set of achievements alongside a leaderboard for Hungry House, same as all other levels.
Want to get involved with the community?  We've added a button to the credits menu that will send you to our official Discord server!
A new skin can be unlocked by doing something in Hungry House, but only after beating the game.
The free soundtrack now includes "Huh2" and "I'm Hungry".  More Beats!  More Tunes!


Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Adjusted an effect on the main menu to increase framerate on Steam Decks and computers using graphics cards with less than 4GB of VRAM.
Volcanic Void has received another optimization pass (this does not affect any level geometry or gameplay).

notes.title: Version 1.0.13 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Intro splash screens and certain visual effects now show up as intended on the Steam Deck/Linux devices.
It is now significantly easier to unlock an achievement related to bonus content on the Steam Deck/Linux devices.

notes.title: Version 1.0.12 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Added full support for PlayStation controllers.

notes.title: Version 1.0.11 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Modified an effect to improve framerate in the first and last levels.

notes.title: Version 1.0.10 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Fixed bug that allowed a level to be loaded twice through an out of bounds exploit.  Sorry speedrunners, this one is too game breaking!

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Fixed a softlock in Appliance Avenue if hitting a prop at a specific angle.
Fixed cheat activation status message appearing slightly off screen on 16:9 displays.
Tweaked text in a couple messages.

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Patch Notes


Prevented jump/spring interaction which resulted in both actions getting cancelled.
Darkened the color of an already obtained prism for improved visual clarity.
Fixed visual glitch on a HUD element if players took longer than expected in Appliance Avenue.
Fixed a few death messages getting cut off on smaller displays.
Added in a few more loading messages.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes/Bug Fixes


Fixed a handful of skybeams not following their triangles in Mad Mountain and Volcanic Void.
Fixed a few loading messages going off screen on smaller displays.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Minor Patches


Added a small visual effect to the combo counter number after reaching the max combo.
Added around 30 new loading and death messages.
Optimized main menu for integrated graphics cards.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update + OST Release
notes.content:
Hello rats, chairs, and rat chairs (???)!  We are pleased to announce that the CHAIRS OST is now out as a free add-on!  Click here to add the soundtrack to your library!  Now, go forth and enjoy listening to some defined BEATS and TUNES!

Below you can also find some patch notes for the game.

Bug Fixes/Minor Patches


The camera now moves at a consistent speed for the final cutscene regardless of V-Sync settings.
Added an arrow to the HUD in the Appliance Avenue tutorial segments to help highlight the charge indicator.
Reworked most in-game UI to support widescreen displays better.
Modified text on the initial warning screen to highlight an accessibility option that may help some players.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Minor Patches


Terrence can no longer help you collect the unlockable skins.  Bad Terrence, no cheating!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Minor Patches


Per feedback, swapped the order of buttons in the pause menu to make it a bit faster to restart a level.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Minor Patches


Fixed fast fall being slower than intended if Vsync was turned on in the settings.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes/Minor Patches


Fixed the press any button prompt appearing too early on the intro text crawl.
Fixed an obscure interaction that could occur which would result in a saved game getting reset if exiting from the final level of the game.  Whoops!
Fixed the intro text crawl being skipped if doing a very specific set of menu inputs after beating the game.
